# react-pixel-cats-and-birds

> React components that add animated pixel-art cats and birds as a page background. Cats wander,
> sit, look around and lie down; birds fly, land and peck. Clicking plays synthesised meows and
> species-specific bird calls (Web Audio API, no audio files). Zero dependencies, React >= 18,
> works in Next.js App Router, Vite, Parcel, webpack 5. Sprites by Pop Shop Packs (used with
> permission, not MIT).

## Install

npm i react-pixel-cats-and-birds

## Usage

```jsx
import {Cats, Birds} from 'react-pixel-cats-and-birds';

<section style={{position: 'relative', minHeight: 600}}>
  <Cats count={10} avoidCenter />
  <Birds count={16} species={['crow', 'cardinal']} />
  <div style={{position: 'relative'}}>content on top</div>
</section>
```

- Components render a canvas that fills the nearest positioned parent; put content after them.
- `<Cats>` props: count, colors, sheets, variety, scale, avoidCenter, sound ('synth' | false | fn), interactive, maxFps, className, style.
- `<Birds>` props: count, species, scale, sound, interactive, maxFps, className, style.
- Bird species: blueJay, cardinal, cedarWaxwing, chickadee, crow, houseFinch, hummingbird, magpie, redRobin, stellersJay, whiteDove, woodThrush.
- Sounds only: `playMeow(preset?)` with presets meow, kittenMew, whinyMeow, shortMew; `playChirp(species?)`; `setVolume(0..1)`; `setMuted(bool)`.
- Audio needs a user gesture first (browser autoplay rules).
